summary: A handheld walkthrough tour of an empty apartment in NYC's Financial District, showing the hallway, bathroom, kitchen, living room, and city window view.

people.description: A maintenance worker in black cleaning the bathroom sink, and another man in a collared shirt walking through the living area.

quality.issues: Quick pans, slight motion blur, brief overexposure when approaching the window.

moments.action: Camera pans into the bathroom showing a maintenance worker scrubbing the pedestal sink
Pan around the compact kitchen showing the refrigerator, gas stove, microwave, and wooden cabinets
Walking into the sunlit empty living room with parquet wood floors toward the large windows
Looking out the large window at the neighboring high-rises and green treetops against a blue sky
good_for: the view from my new place
